## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind an exception to the one [`gmeow:EventSchedule`](../classes/gmeow-EventSchedule.md) whose series it overrides — the back-edge that lets a schedule enumerate its deviations.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one (it is functional — an exception belongs to one schedule) and avoid pointing it at the affected occurrence; the occurrence is identified by [`gmeow:exceptionOriginalDate`](gmeow-exceptionOriginalDate.md).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:EventSchedule`](../classes/gmeow-EventSchedule.md), then identify the overridden instance with [`gmeow:exceptionOriginalDate`](gmeow-exceptionOriginalDate.md) and classify it with [`gmeow:exceptionType`](gmeow-exceptionType.md).
